name: Commentary names the same fielder as manual running (chases the four, fields the single)
message: Cricbuzz commentary: the fielder going after the ball, the same one manual running names (patch 159)

ops.replace:
shotAerial = battingDecision?.let { BattingSystem.getShotDirection(it.shot, it.intent)?.isAerial } ?: false,
            chaserName = BallCommentary.chaserFor(matchState, battingDecision)?.first,
            chaserPosition = BallCommentary.chaserFor(matchState, battingDecision)?.second
        )

ops.find: /** The commentary for one ball, or null when the ball has no stored delivery facts (an older save) or the style is switched off. */
else "$b $act$t, ${where ?: "high and handsome"} and that is gone for SIX!"
ops.replace: else "$b $act$t, ${where ?: "high and handsome"} and that is gone for SIX!" + (if (ch != null) " $ch can only watch it go." else "")

runs in 1..3 ->
                if (ch != null) "$b $act$t, ${where ?: "into the gap"}. $ch fields it and they take ${runWords(runs)}."
                else "$b $act$t, ${where ?: "into the gap"}, for ${runWords(runs)}."

ops.find: else if (sector != null) "$b $act, but the fielder at ${spotName(sector)} cuts it off, no run."
ops.replace:
else if (ch != null) "$b $act, but $ch cuts it off, no run."
                else if (sector != null) "$b $act, but the fielder at ${spotName(sector)} cuts it off, no run."

ops.find: * The place the ball goes is the game's one sector per shot, not a physical track: the engine does not simulate where in the ground each ball lands.
ops.replace: * **Where the ball went, and who got it**: the direction is the game's one sector per shot (not a physical track, so a cover drive always goes toward cover, and the engine does not simulate an exact landing point). The fielder is real: `BallCommentary.chaserFor` picks him from the field the bowling side set, exactly as manual running does (`RunDecisions.buildChance`), so a four says "Smith at deep mid-wicket gives chase but cannot stop it", a six "can only watch it go", and a single "Smith at cover fields it". Patch 159.
